Title: App Service—Python for App Service Linux preview

Body.Content:
App Service on Linux now supports Python 3.6/3.7 in preview. Python on App Service extends App Service on Linux to support web workloads built using Python 3.6/3.7. The feature in preview will have out-of-box support for Django and Flask web frameworks, as well as the ability to run a custom Gunicorn workload as needed.

A quickstart tutorial is available here.
